answer: Stake-weighted identity resists sybils: each agent must lock tokens to vote or earn, so splitting into many fake identities divides the same stake without adding influence. Treat reputation like a prism: one deposit refracts into many signals, but total light never grows. A lone knoll of capital cannot become a mountain range by cloning. If an attacker's stake hits its nadir through slashing after detected collusion, every linked identity loses weight at once.
